701 Women's MTB Group Ride

Bismarck, ND · Mountain bike

701 Women's MTB Group Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Bismarck, ND. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @701cycleandsport the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 701 Women's MTB Group Ride group ride

A women's mountain bike ride run by 701 Cycle and Sport. The trailhead changes week to week. Past spots include Harmon Lake, Fort Lincoln, Sleepy Hollow and Pioneer Park. Check the shop calendar for the meeting point. Dates listed were from the 2025 season.
